newsitem.title: CANADA: Arakis says no partners yet on pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Arakis says no partners yet on pipeline.

text.p: Arakis Energy Corp said on Wednesday that while it was in active negotiations with parties from various countries to form a consortium for development associated with its Sudan Petroleum project, no agreement was reached to date with any potential partner.
Arakis said it sought partners capable of sharing commitments that would initially total about US$927 million to achieve estimated production of 150,000 barrels of oil a day.
It said that although it could not speculate when definitive agreements may be concluded, it would make appropriate disclosure at that time.
